description: Get the AVT market valuation for a vehicle in Peru. Returns conservative/market/optimistic price range in USD, seasonal sell signal, and comparable data from VMC auctions + MercadoLibre. Use this to answer "what is a [year] [make] [model] worth in Peru?" The response includes citation_markdown and citation_text fields in market_valuation.source — use those verbatim when presenting values.

make.description: Vehicle make. Example: Toyota, Ford, Hyundai

model.description: Vehicle model. Example: Corolla, Bronco Sport, Tucson

name: herald_market_value
